name: Blood Hawk
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Perception +6. Passive Perception 16. Languages none.
appearance: A rust-red hawk with a hooked bill, banded tail, folded wings and pale underparts.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 350, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5194927-blood-hawk
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. When attacking a creature, roll with advantage if an ally within 5 ft. of that creature is free of the Incapacitated condition.
sections.Actions: Beak. Make a melee attack roll at +4 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Use 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if the target is Bloodied.

name: Boar
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Passive Perception 9. Languages none.
appearance: A dark, bristly boar with a low head, raised shoulders and curved tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 350, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775805-boar
sections.Traits: Bloodied Fury. Roll attacks with advantage while the boar is Bloodied.
sections.Actions: Gore. Make a melee attack roll at +3 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the boar moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it just before the hit, deal another 3 (1d6) piercing damage and apply Prone to the target.
